blocks.title: Front matter
blocks.content:
Θ-Categories and Tannakian duality
Joost NUITEN, Bertrand TOEN
July 2025
Abstract
We introduce a notion of Θ-categories, which is a refinement of the
notion of symmetric monoidal ∞-categories.
We use this notion to
prove a Tannakian duality statement, relating Θ-categories with fpqc-
stacks by means of a certain stack of fiber functors in the context of
Θ-categories. This provides, over a base ring of arbitrary characteris-
tic, a strong link between Tannakian Θ-categories and the schematic
homotopy types of [Toe06].

## $\mu$-Categories

We let $\infty\text{-}\mathbf{Cat}_{pr}^{R}$ be the $(2,\infty)$-category of presentable $(1,\infty)$-categories and right adjoints (i.e. limit preserving accessible $\infty$-functors). We have the corresponding $(2,\infty)$-category $\mathsf{Fun}(\Delta^1,\infty\text{-}\mathbf{Cat}^{R}_{pr})$, of morphisms in $\infty\text{-}\mathbf{Cat}_{pr}^{R}$. For any object $f \colon T' \to T$ in $\mathsf{Fun}(\Delta^1,\infty\text{-}\mathbf{Cat}^R_{pr})$, we will denote by $f^* \colon T \to T'$ the left adjoint to $f$, and sometimes write $f_*$ instead of $f$.

blocks.title: Tannaka duality
blocks.content: In this section, we fix a commutative ground ring $k$. We denote by $\mathbf{St}_k$ the $\infty$-category of stacks on the big site of affine $k$-schemes endowed with the fpqc topology.

blocks.title: The Tannakian duality theorem
blocks.content:
We start by investigating the morphism $\beta$.

::: thm
[]{#t1 label="t1"} Let $T^\Theta$ be a neutralized Tannakian $\Theta$-category over $k$. Then the following hold.

1.  The unit morphism of $\Theta$-categories $\beta_{T^\Theta}\colon T^\Theta \to \mathsf{QCoh}^{\mathrm{LSym}}(\mathsf{Fib}^{\mathrm{LSym}}_*(T^\Theta))$ induces an equivalence of symmetric monoidal $\infty$-categories $$T \simeq \widehat{\mathsf{Perf}}(\mathsf{Fib}^{\mathrm{LSym}}_*(T^\Theta)).$$

2.  The stack $\mathsf{Fib}_*^{\mathrm{LSym}}(T^\Theta)$ is a pointed Tannakian gerbe.
:::
